title: Northgate Protect Terms and Conditions: Cancellation and Refunds
content:
**Who cancels.** Cancelling a plan is the plan holder's own decision, recorded as a cancellation request and confirmed by the plan holder; the return of the covered item to Northgate cancels its single-item plan without a separate request.

**One refund per charge.** Each plan charge is refunded at most once, and the refund goes to the method that paid it.

**Item returned or canceled.** When the covered item is returned or canceled the refund is the full plan price, with the basis item returned, whatever the timing.

**Full-refund window.** Otherwise a full refund applies only when the cancellation date is no later than the plan purchase date plus the tier's full refund window days, and only when no claim has been filed on the plan from the plan purchase date to the cancellation date, inclusive. Calendar days are added to the plan purchase date, the day after the purchase being day 1, and a cancellation on the last day still qualifies.

**Prorated refund (retired clause).** Outside that, a one-time plan refunds the plan price times the unused coverage days divided by the total coverage days, less a cancellation fee equal to the lesser of the tier's cancellation fee percentage of the plan price and the tier's cancellation fee cap, rounded down to the cent and never below zero, with the basis prorated unused days; the unused coverage days run from the day after the cancellation date through the day before the coverage end date (none when the cancellation date is on or after that day), the total coverage days run from the coverage start date through the day before the coverage end date, and before coverage starts every coverage day is unused. — *This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis for cancellation refunds on one-time plans.*

**After a settled claim.** No cancellation refund is paid after a replacement or reimbursement settlement on the plan.

**Complete Monthly.** Northgate Protect Complete Monthly may be canceled at any time effective at once, and the current month's fee is not refunded outside the full-refund window.

**Charges in error.** A charge made in error is refunded in full, with the basis billing error.

**Tier terms.** The item-return refund follows the tier's item-return refund term, proration follows the tier's prorated refund basis and refund rounding, and no tier pays a cancellation refund after a settled claim.

## The full-refund window, read closely

- **Clock start:** the plan purchase date (or enrollment date) on the plan record.
- **Counting:** calendar days, the day after the purchase being day 1; a cancellation on the last day qualifies.
- **Second condition:** no claim filed on the plan from its purchase date to the cancellation date.
- *Hypothetical, with a 30-day window:* a plan bought on 1 March. Day 30 is 31 March. Cancelled on 31 March with no claim filed, it is refunded in full; cancelled on 31 March after one claim was filed, or on 1 April, the full-refund window does not apply.

## Charge already refunded

A plan charge that already carries a refund is not refunded again; the refund once made is credited to the method that paid the charge.
